operator_attestation.source: device owner in the active 2026-08-13 implementation session
operator_attestation.statement_paraphrase: The firmware supplied on this exact device supported touchscreen input and played audio out of the box.

saved_factory_image.claim_limit: Strings prove the relevant factory implementation was linked into the saved exact-unit image; they do not independently prove which branch executed or acoustic output.

narrow_audio_contract.amplitude_policy: volume 10 preserves the signed PCM16 input without amplification; lower values attenuate proportionally

touch_authorization_decision.basis: The complete GT911 bus, reset, address-latch, power, and ground path is invariant across published V1.0/V1.1/V1.2 designs; the pinned factory source selects the same settings; the saved image links the GT911 service; and the device owner attests that factory touch worked on this exact unit. This permits one narrow persistent touch demo while independent coordinate acceptance remains pending.

audio_authorization_decision.basis: Pinned factory source and the exact-unit owner report justify implementing and build-testing the factory-direct backend, but they do not satisfy the existing power-off release condition for converging amplifier outputs.
audio_authorization_decision.release_condition: With power removed, prove by physical population and continuity that one speaker-output amplifier family is absent or electrically isolated before any GPIO30-low run.

independent_acceptance_required_after_in: exact app-partition readback matches the reviewed artifact
serial confirms GT911 initialization at 0x5d or 0x14 without repeated failures
serial confirms monotonically increasing Doom frames with zero video failures
a person physically confirms touch controls change the game state
after the separate audio release condition, serial confirms increasing audio frames with zero write failures and a person confirms audible undistorted SFX
claims_not_made: The project independently observed the original factory touch session.
The project independently measured the original factory acoustic output.
A power-off population inventory proved which speaker-amplifier family is stuffed.
The published NC markings alone prove the direct amplifier population.
Serial audio frame counts prove acoustic output.
Touch initialization proves coordinate or gesture correctness.
